unverifiable_exemptions: Motel or hotel space rented day-to-day to transients
Dwellings or portions rented for commercial use
Units rehabilitated under Federal/State Rental Rehabilitation Programs receiving Section 8 subsidies or federal housing vouchers (only while in the program)
Units under a contract giving a governmental agency authority to regulate rents that supersedes the City's authority (only during the contract)
Vacant dwellings exempted under § 19:2-18.2 (vacant at least 18 months and substantially rehabilitated, 5-year exemption granted by the Rent Control Board)
coverage.summary: Applies to dwelling units in multiple dwellings covered by the Newark rent control chapter. That means all multiple dwellings (any building with one or more apartments rented or offered for rent), except the exempt dwellings listed in § 19:2-2.

evidence.quoted_span: All multiple dwellings, as defined in subsection 19:2-2, are subject to Rent Control pursuant to this Title XIX Rent Control,
Shall mean and include any building or structure and land appurtenant thereto containing one or more apartments or rented or offered for rent to one or more tenants or family units.
No landlord shall bring any action to recover possession of a dwelling unit as a reprisal for the tenant's efforts to secure or enforce any right under this chapter.
All multiple dwellings, as defined in subsection 19:2-2, are subject to Rent Control pursuant to this Title XIX Rent Control,
Newly constructed multiple dwellings and vacant dwellings as set forth in this chapter at Subsections 19:2-18.1 and 19:2-18.2, respectively;
for a period of time not to exceed the period of amortization of any initial mortgage loan obtained for the multiple dwelling, or for 30 years following completion of construction, whichever is less.
Shall mean the issuance of a Certificate of Occupancy pursuant to the "State Uniform Construction Code Act"

the landlord of any newly constructed dwelling shall apply to the Rent Control Board for a Certification that the dwelling, or portion thereof with respect to Temporary Certificates of Occupancy, is granted an exemption from any restrictions in the rent that the landlord may charge.
Any motel or hotel space rented on a day-to-day basis to transients;
Any dwelling, building or structure, or portion thereof, rented for commercial use;

Those units which have been rehabilitated by the Federal and State Rental Rehabilitation Programs as administered by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, the New Jersey Department of Community Affairs or the New Jersey Housing Mortgage Finance Agency and will be receiving Section 8 rent subsidies or Federal housing vouchers.

A contract between a landlord and a governmental agency duly providing for that governmental agency to regulate the amount of rent received by that landlord provided that, if the authority of that governmental agency supersedes the authority of the City of Newark to regulate such rents, then the application of this chapter shall be preempted during the period of governmental agency regulation specified in the contract.

Dwellings which become vacant and remain vacant for a minimum of 18 months or dwellings which are already vacant on the effective date of this section shall be exempt for a period of five years from any restrictions in the rent that the landlord may charge

result.notes: Added a new-construction exemption and the § 19:2-2 exemptions as unverifiable_exemptions. The exemption is the lesser of 30 years from the certificate of occupancy or the initial mortgage amortization period, and the owner must apply to the Rent Control Board. years=30 is the maximum. Caveat: the § 19:2-2 EXEMPTIONS definition says the chapter 'shall not apply' to new and vacant exempt dwellings. But §§ 19:2-18.1 and 18.2 only lift the limits on rent increases, so it is unclear whether the § 19:2-14 reprisal bar also lapses for exempt new construction. Reviewers should check this. 'Owner occupied' is defined (four units or fewer) but is used only for inspection fees, not as a coverage exemption, so owner_occupied_exemption_max_units stays null. No construction-date cutoff exists. requires_unknown_facts stays false because the chapter covers ordinary multiple dwellings.
